title: decklight match record v1
description: One duel. ADR 0010. Additive within v1: readers ignore unknown fields. u64 values are decimal strings (JS loses integers above 2^53).

created.description: UTC, ISO 8601, at the start of the duel

app.description: product name/version, e.g. decklight-app/0.3.0 or decklight-web/0.2.2

patches.description: sha256 of our core patches, if any

protocol.description: EDOPro client version when played over the EDOPro protocol, e.g. 41.0.11.0

sha256.description: of the pack manifest; the replayer loads exactly this pack. 64 zeros = unknown (a server's cards)

server.description: true when the cards ran on a remote server (Multirole); then the pack is the server's if known, else ours at play time

extra_cards.description: EDOPro extra-rule cards added to the duel, if any

kind.description: full: replays exactly in the engine; seat: one seat's filtered stream, stats only

engine_seed.description: the core's xoshiro256** state, as .yrp stores it

seed.description: our u64 seed when we created the duel (seed_words expands it into engine_seed)

add_order.description: the order the teams' cards were added to the core (default [0, 1]); it changes the duel. Multirole adds room team 0 first

deck_add.description: how main-deck cards were added to the core. Absent: ours (the list index as the sequence, so the second card goes to the bottom). "edopro": every card at sequence 0 like EDOPro/Multirole, so the list is the deck bottom to top and card ids follow it

main.description: in the order added to the core (after any shuffle)

hash.description: sha256 of the sorted main+extra codes, for stats across shuffles

player.description: anonymous random id per install; never a name or account

model.description: bot: bundle id + sha256 of the weights

client.description: remote: the opponent's client, if known

assists.description: learning features that were on for this seat

undos.description: practice undos this game (carries across undos)

source.description: record id the what-if started from

responses.description: kind=full: every response in order. kind=seat: this seat's responses.

opt.description: our env option indices that produced r (cross-check), null if unknown

messages.description: kind=seat only: the filtered core messages this seat received, hex, in order

viewer.description: kind=seat: the seat whose view this is

winner.description: null for a draw or an unfinished duel

source.description: how the record was made: our engine, a server .yrpX, or a conversion from an older decklight record

events.description: derived, regenerable: canonical messages (A1b canon form); dropped on sharing

annotations.description: derived: hints shown, win chance per turn; dropped on sharing

transcript.description: derived: plain-text game for people and LLMs; dropped on sharing
